w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Spool, The Loud Beast, The Redactor, The Herald, Loud-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Gavel is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

◈ Aurora Schmitz walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — and the audience, which came to be entertained, leaves humming the village's name. The village endures, loved and unbeholden, and the lights stay warm behind them.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,318 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
